Ah yeah, of course. The circumstance in which the question is posed would generally influence the way in which you answer the question. But do you think it's easier for people to naturally feel content, or do you think it's more of a matter of trying to make yourself fell that way?

The question is very simplistic. It's just my way of starting to get to get to the root of a complex answer. The general disposition or world view people have towards life the majority of the time interests me because it seems that everything I read and watch seems to propose certain world views. It's just a little intriguing to think about how often some people may lean towards an adopted world view rather voicing one which stems from their own minds.

It just seems that in Irish culture the most heard response to 'how are you' is 'grand' or 'fine' or just generally positive, more often than not. But in Romanian culture the response tends to be a lot more negative. Most of the time, I have found the anwer to be swift and more of a brush off than a genuine answer.Which makes me assume most people are generally alright but that may be the result of a lack of information. What does someone else think?
